Table 1 lists F1 scores of models predicting with sentence-level context on CoNLL-2003. For mod- els that we trained, we report F1 and standard deviation obtained by averaging over 10 random restarts. The Viterbi-decoding Bi-LSTM-CRF and ID-CNN-CRF and greedy ID-CNN obtain the highest average scores, with the ID-CNN- CRF outperforming the Bi-LSTM-CRF by 0.11 points of F1 on average, and the Bi-LSTM-CRF out-performing the greedy ID-CNN by 0.11 as well. Our greedy ID-CNN outperforms the Bi- LSTM and the 4-layer CNN, which uses the same number of parameters as the ID-CNN, and per- forms similarly to the 5-layer CNN which uses more parameters but covers the same effective in- put width.
